description: Compare prices for a specific fashion product across all stores on Realry.com. Returns stores sorted cheapest first with direct purchase links, the sizes each store lists, and how fresh each store's stock data is.

country.description: Two-letter market code deciding shipping availability, prices and currency. Defaults to US when omitted or unrecognised. Pass the shopper's own country — prices and stock differ per market.

product_id.description: Product ID from search_products result (shown as "Product ID: `xxx`")

name: get_price_comparison
title: Compare Prices
